analysis.summary: Madison arrives at her industrial artist space carrying paint supplies and groceries, only to find an eviction notice from the City Marshall and a chain and lock on her door. She drops her supplies and calls Jason, but the answering machine picks up. She leaves a desperate message asking him to pick up and saying she needs him, then puts away the phone and picks up her supplies.
